title: The Slower Ball (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal cricket philosophy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The slower ball is a conversation about time
About how fast you think you are
And how fast you actually are
Those are frequently two different things

[Verse 2]
You grip it differently
You release it the same way
Everything about the body says express
And then the ball arrives at a different speed to the one he expected

[Chorus]
The slower ball says — I know what you're expecting
The slower ball says — and I'm not going to do it
The slower ball says — you've made up your mind already
The slower ball says — that's the problem, isn't it

[Bridge]
Chas said — the slower ball is about patience
Not yours — his
You're perfectly calm
He's the one who has to decide
In the half a second he has left

[Verse 3]
Most batsmen know the slower ball is coming
That's not the point
The point is knowing it's coming and still not being ready
That's the slower ball
That's the point of the slower ball

[Outro]
The slower ball
The slower ball
That's my boy
